opportunities.name: Detonation Ally Mark
opportunities.objective: Log allied damage within Q mark and detonation delay.
opportunities.mechanic: Three Blaze stacks explode after two seconds and apply spell effects. Q stuns an already Ablaze target, allowing Mandate vulnerability before the delayed explosion and allied follow-up. Rylai tests retention; Blackfire benefits from actual spread.
opportunities.requiredState: Apply Blaze before Q and complete three stacks with an ally nearby.
opportunities.failure: Missed Q or spread targets prevent the overlap.
opportunities.test: Log allied damage within Q mark and detonation delay; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Blaze slow alone is not Mandate immobilization.

opportunities.name: Self Bounce Retention
opportunities.objective: Record every R recipient while varying Brand distance.
opportunities.mechanic: R can bounce to Brand and prioritizes Blaze stacking; E doubles spread on Ablaze. Riftmaker can ramp through sustained combat, Cosmic repositions the bounce anchor and Zhonya tests pressure survival. Shadowflame affects qualifying low-health magic packets.
opportunities.requiredState: Stay within bounce spacing with enough health to survive.
opportunities.failure: Retreat strands bounces or stasis changes routing.
opportunities.test: Record every R recipient while varying Brand distance; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Five bounces are not five hits on one champion.

ruledOut.reason: Ordinary attacks do not apply spell Blaze stacks.

unknowns: Burn reapplication intervals and self-bounce behavior during stasis require live testing.

builds.name: Detonation Ally Mark
builds.summary: Log allied damage within Q mark and detonation delay.
builds.goal: Log allied damage within Q mark and detonation delay.
builds.hypothesis: Three Blaze stacks explode after two seconds and apply spell effects. Q stuns an already Ablaze target, allowing Mandate vulnerability before the delayed explosion and allied follow-up. Rylai tests retention; Blackfire benefits from actual spread.
testPlan: Required state: Apply Blaze before Q and complete three stacks with an ally nearby.
Log allied damage within Q mark and detonation delay; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Missed Q or spread targets prevent the overlap.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Blaze slow alone is not Mandate immobilization.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Imperial Mandate, Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Blackfire Torch, Cryptbloom, Rabadon's Deathcap, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Brand's Abilities light his targets Ablaze, dealing [2]% max Health magic damage over 4 seconds. If Brand kills a unit that is Ablaze, he regains [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=20, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 3, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 3.3299999237060547, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 3.3299999237060547, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 9, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 3.3299999237060547, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 12, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 3.3299999237060547, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 15, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 3.3329999446868896, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 18, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 3.3299999237060547, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] mana. Blaze can stack up to 3 times.

When a champion or large jungle monster reaches 3 stacks, the Blaze will detonate after 2 seconds, dealing [(characterLevelInterpolation(6 → 12; raw flags preserved) + (0.02) × AP) × (0.01)] max Health magic damage to surrounding enemies.

Brand conjures a powerful blast at his target, dealing [55 / 80 / 105 / 130 / 155 + (0.6) × AP] magic damage to surrounding units.

If the target is Ablaze, the spread range is doubled.

Brand unleashes a devastating torrent of fire that can bounce to Brand or another enemy up to 5 times, dealing [100 / 175 / 250 + (0.3) × AP] magic damage to enemies each bounce. Bounces prioritize stacking Blaze to max on champions.

If the target is Ablaze, they are briefly Slowed by [30 / 45 / 60]%.

Brand launches a fireball that deals [70 / 100 / 130 / 160 / 190 + (0.65) × AP] magic damage to the first enemy hit.

If the target is Ablaze, they will be Stunned for [1.75] seconds.
